issues.title: Skill-count summary misreports when no sibling xian-* skills exist
issues.recommendation: In install_all and verify_all, `printf '%s\n' $SKILL_NAMES | wc -l` yields 1 even when SKILL_NAMES is empty, so the summary would print "skills: 1 + 1" when no sibling xian-* skills exist in .codex/skills. Display-only edge case (this repo has xian-open/xian-spec); consider guarding the empty case or computing the count while building SKILL_NAMES.

issues.title: README hub bullet says `prompt` but implementation links the `prompts` directory
issues.recommendation: Minor documentation accuracy nit: the hub bullet in README.md and README_EN.md lists the linked artifact as `prompt` (singular), while sync-global.sh actually links the `prompts` directory (ensure_hub_link "$XIAN_COMMIT_HUB/prompts"). Correct the wording to `prompts/` in both READMEs so AC-004's directory description matches the implementation; purely cosmetic, no behavior impact.

issues.title: Orphaned managed links for skills removed from the source repo are not enumerated by status/uninstall
issues.recommendation: SKILL_NAMES is derived from the current repo listing (.codex/skills/xian-*), so a link created by an earlier sync for a skill later removed from the repo is no longer enumerated: uninstall will not remove it and status/verify will not report it. Not an AC violation (drift is documented as exposed via status/verify for tracked skills), but recording the managed skill list in the .xian-global-managed marker at install time and having status/uninstall read it would close this lifecycle gap.

issues.title: Bundle reviewer policy pins codex-cli while this change's reviews execute on a Claude reviewer
issues.recommendation: Carried over from both spec reviews: bundle policy pins specReview/buildReview reviewer runtime to codex-cli, while the change rationale states a Claude-reviewer restart and both spec reviews plus this build review executed on a Claude runtime. Align the harness reviewer policy with the intended runtime so future review dispatches do not depend on fallback. Configuration alignment note only; not a defect in this build snapshot.
